author: PavelMakarchuk
body:
Checked the official VT DOR myVTax guide ([GB-1128, July 2024](https://tax.vermont.gov/myvtax/RCC-146-instructions)) and 32 V.S.A. § 6066–6068 to clarify both questions:

**Is it refundable or non-refundable?**
Functionally **refundable**. Per DOR's myVTax guide: *"Select No to have the entire credit amount paid out to you"* and *"You are not required to file income tax forms to receive the Renter Credit."* A filer with zero VT tax liability still receives the full credit as a check. The statute doesn't explicitly use the word "refundable," but the administrative behavior is.

**Where does it go?**
Filed on Form RCC-146, **not** on Form IN-111. The filer can elect to apply it against any VT income tax owed (the "Yes" option), or have it paid out as a separate refund check (the "No" option, default for filers without income tax owed). So it doesn't appear as a line on IN-111 unless the filer elects to apply it against tax owed.

**PE-US treatment**: [`vt_renter_credit.py`](https://github.com/PolicyEngine/policyengine-us/blob/master/policyengine_us/variables/gov/states/vt/tax/income/credits/renter/vt_renter_credit.py) computes the credit (per 32 V.S.A. § 6066(b) + the [VT DOR county-by-county Excel sheet](https://tax.vermont.gov/individuals/renter-credit/calculator-and-credit-amounts)) but does **not** wire it into any aggregate yet — neither `vt_refundable_credits` nor `state_property_tax_credits`. Filed PolicyEngine/policyengine-us#8555 to add it to `state_property_tax_credits` (the household aggregate, same place as `mn_renters_credit`), not to `vt_income_tax`. That preserves the form-line treatment (credit not on IN-111) while making the benefit visible as a state household benefit.

**Your TAXSIM disabling looks right** for siitax purposes — the credit isn't on IN-111, so excluding it from siitax matches the form, TaxAct, and PE. The credit is a separate VT benefit, not a part of state income tax liability.

Closing as PE-consistent with your treatment; PE-US #8555 will surface the benefit at the household level without changing siitax.
